posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif delighted fans with her May photo dump featuring sweet moments with baby Vihaan and mushy pics with husband Vicky Kaushal, including a birthday picnic setup reading 'Happy Birthday Papa.'

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh's Main Vaapas Aaunga set for June 12 release, after the star made history selling out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden on his AURA world tour.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt's spy thriller Alpha with Sharvari preponed to July 3 release — she plays an assassin in what YRF calls a groundbreaking all-female action film.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Nick Jonas reveals daughter Malti's favorite jams at home with Priyanka Chopra, calling fatherhood 'the best part' as the couple balances Hollywood careers with family life.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Shah Rukh Khan's new Visa 'Infinitely More' campaign has fans convinced it's a secret teaser for his upcoming thriller King, set for Christmas 2026 alongside daughter Suhana Khan.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena Kapoor Khan turned heads at sister Karisma's neo-noir thriller 'Brown' screening alongside Saif Ali Khan, while son Taimur earns his taekwondo yellow belt.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor reportedly sustained a fracture while shooting for Eetha, pausing production as fans eagerly await the Stree 2 release.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone will use a body double for action scenes in Allu Arjun's Raka amid her second pregnancy, while fans buzz about a possible White Lotus Season 4 role.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh's Don 3 exit saga continues as FWICE withdraws its non-cooperation directive, while the Producers Guild pushes for an amicable resolution with Excel Entertainment.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Filmfare's editor-in-chief defends Aishwarya Rai Bachchan against cruel online body-shaming, calling her an icon who still owns the red carpet despite unfair scrutiny.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika Mandanna shares playful BTS moments from Cocktail 2 with director Homi Adajania, ahead of the film's June 19 release alongside Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu is enjoying married life with husband Raj Nidimoru, while her upcoming film Maa Inti Bangaaram generates buzz with its emotional trailer.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's next blockbuster Raka with director Atlee and Deepika Padukone is in production, as the Pushpa superstar continues his reign as Telugu cinema's biggest draw.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama Peddi smashed box office records with a ₹112 crore opening day worldwide, earning an emotional tribute from father Chiranjeevi.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Dragon first glimpse with director Prashanth Neel unveiled to massive fan frenzy, as the RRR star gears up for his next blockbuster.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor faces a backlash over objectification concerns in Ram Charan's Peddi, as director Buchi Babu Sana promises to address the criticism.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday celebrated turning 27 with birthday love from Suhana Khan, Shanaya Kapoor, Kareena and Varun, as she settles into her swanky new Mumbai home.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani is gearing up for War 2 alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR, calling the experience of working on YRF's spy thriller 'unforgettable.'

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan praises Jr NTR as 'simply amazing' ahead of their epic dance-off in War 2, calling their collaboration on the YRF spy sequel 'nerve-wracking.'

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai — father David Dhawan's final directorial — opened to ₹7.5 crore with critics calling it a 'genuine family entertainer.'

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal continues to mesmerize audiences on her All Hearts Tour, with the melody queen performing across Indian cities to an overwhelming fan response.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman will perform a special BSF tribute 'Jai Ho' at the Attari Border on June 7 for Main Vaapas Aaunga, while his Peddi score earns rave reviews from audiences.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay was sworn in as Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister after his TVK party's historic election victory, marking the superstar's full transition from cinema to politics.
